name: zC400569 (Hubble)
blurb: zC400569, a massive star-forming disk galaxy in the distant universe, seen by Hubble.
label: zc400569-hubble
story: A distant, massive galaxy caught while forming stars at a furious pace, its rotating disk already holding a substantial central bulge. Hubble's sharp view maps where its stars lie, to learn how bulges and disks grew in young galaxies.

claims.text: zC400569 is a massive star-forming galaxy at z~2 (z = 2.24), a rotating disk with a significant stellar bulge
Program 12578 imaged it among 21 massive star-forming galaxies at z~2 to map stellar mass distribution and witness the growth of bulges and disks
